nodes.title: director18: Brain v6.9 + Studio v6.9 + Learning D12 on int/r6 2239d0005, run by main, 16 lessons, 1,513 calls ~$1.044; counted by hand by 4 Claude judges on Opus 5.5 (0-based rows): beats 284/287, verdicts 248/248, misgrades 0, false keys 0, unsaid boards 0 (director17: 8), held-cost contradictions 0, paging contradictions 0; words against board 9 (c4 1, c5-t01 3, c5-t02 3, c6 2), all nine a picture request whose line describes a second view that was not drawn (record drawn:'kept'); the other 7 of 16 picture requests drew a true split view; 18/18 bridges switched at their first spoken part; listening c4 3.5, c5-t01 3, c5-t02 3, c6 3.5; register c4 3, c5-t02 3; c6 passes every axis. layout recorded on 0 rows.

Script walk v6.10: one draw, one line; the request table's wrong and missing rows; her joints authored. P6: a picture turn is one function returning the drawing and the line built from it (held board left, view right); 'kept' never applies to a picture turn with a view; no view -> no picture line, one honest sentence; a predicate throws when a picture line is spoken with no view in the record; fixtures are director18's 9 rows; production's seam and the harness use the same function and the record carries layout. T2: a test per not-followed row (clarify at a point's check-in re-says the point; an aside with no card open is not parked 'is sawaal ke baad'; 'ab se Hindi mein' with nothing live changes the language; an aside during a worked step is answered first); a language or clarify request never spends a card's simpler or remediation; after an aside reply the walk resumes at the unit's next unsaid part; an answer given before the card was posed is asked for once more, never keyed; try-first with no card open poses the card; 'Kuch poochna hai?' removed as a check-in form. A6: the aside acknowledgement is removed (fitted 0 times in two runs). R7: after a give-up the key and why, then a check-in, next point next turn; a step opener names its own step or is omitted; nothing appended after a bridge. Harness: the child sim does not answer an unsaid card; goodbye waits for an open card; changed/kept compare against the board up before the turn. Learning D13: aside park, aside return (with a slot for what the child said), Hindi switch and ask-again lines authored per topic, three forms each; c4 s2 e3 on a new heap; c5-t02 e1 why as a sentence, gap remediation one part short and true of unshaded bars, s1 c1 answer board shaded; the staged 30-topic batch is regenerated under D11-D13 and stays staged. Clause 2 of v6.9 (listening < 3.5 with T1) taken: rules not followed are fixed in the runtime, rules wrong or missing are re-authored with Learning. Plan change: the pilot loop becomes one stream of three; the main effort moves to learner state changing what is taught and generated content reaching a child. Reverse in director19: a picture line with no view drawn -> picture requests answered with the held board and one honest line until Studio's view passes a fixture per pilot board template; listening still < 3.5 in a topic -> that topic's failing request handling is authored turn by turn in the script and code stops choosing; register < 3.5 with authored joints -> every remaining code-written sentence is listed and authored or removed; any misgrade, unsaid board or held cost -> as in v6.9's clauses.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-script-walk-v6-10` (2026-11-10)

One draw, one line; the request table's wrong and missing rows; her joints authored.

**Brain and Studio:**
- **P6:** a picture turn is one function that returns the drawing and the line built from it. No view, no picture line. A predicate throws when a picture line is spoken with no view in the record. Production and the harness use the same function.
- **T2:** a test per row that was not followed; a language or clarify request never spends a card's help; after an aside reply the walk resumes at the unit's next unsaid part; an early answer is asked for once more, never keyed; try-first with no card open poses the card.
- **A6:** the aside acknowledgement is removed.
- **R7:** after a give-up, the key and why, then a check-in; step openers name their own step; nothing is appended after a bridge.

**Learning (D13):** the aside park, aside return, Hindi switch and ask-again lines are authored per topic, three forms each; four data fixes in c4 and c5-t02; the staged 30-topic batch is regenerated under D11 to D13 and stays staged.

**Why:** paging is gone (0 unsaid boards, 0 held cost), and the 9 contradictions left are one two-call bug: `heldAltOf` writes the picture line and `heldBoard` separately decides to keep the board. The acknowledgement and the fixed aside sentences are code-written sentences said in every lesson, the same fault as the verdict frames of director13 to 15, and get the same cure.

**Plan change:** the pilot loop becomes one stream of three. The main effort moves to learner state changing what is taught, and generated content reaching a child.

**Reverse if, in director19:**
- a picture line is spoken with no view drawn: picture requests are answered with the held board and one honest line until Studio's view passes a fixture for every pilot board template;
- listening is still below 3.5 in a topic: that topic's failing request handling is authored turn by turn in the script, and code stops choosing;
- register is below 3.5 with authored joints: every remaining code-written sentence is listed and authored or removed;
- any misgrade, unsaid board or held cost: as in v6.9's clauses.
